title: Vintage Disney Store Aladdin 12 OZ Mug / Cup - New With Box
descriptionText:
Comes with box. Box is damaged.

This vintage Disney Store Aladdin mug is a must-have for any Disney fan! The 12 oz mug features Aladdin, the beloved character from the classic Disney movie. The mug is made from high-quality materials and comes with the original box. It is perfect for collectors or anyone who loves Disney memorabilia. The mug is part of the Disney Mug collection and is a featured refinement of the Disneyana Contemporary (1968-Now) category. Add this mug to your collection today!
